_doc: Emergent NPC questlines, the Spelunky 2 way (round 39). Nothing is announced: no HUD text, no list. `npcs` are the people (hub lines per stage; `thanks` is said in the hub the first time you visit after the stage was reached; Quill has `relics` lines, one per relic handed over); `quests` are the encounters met in the levels: a row is eligible when the person's stage is between `need` and `max` (inclusive) on one of the listed levels (0 = Shallows 1-1), rolls `chance` once per level, and when finished moves the stage up by exactly one. kinds: vault (sealed in a rock pocket: bomb it open), rescue (a cage on a floor: break it with a dash or a bomb, the critter follows, bring it to the exit). lines: meet, ask (said as you approach), help (when you act), thank (right after). The Collector has no level row: he moves into the hub after your first dive. The Challenge Pool is a set-piece room (pool.js).

1: Fresh air at last. Thank you!
The current keeps burying me down there. Dig me out again, if you find me.
2: One more rescue, and I will make it worth your while.
3: A ring in the floor, straight to the third cave. It is yours.

thanks.1: Out of the rock! Find me at the hub.
thanks.2: Free again! You are getting good at this.
thanks.3: Three times! There is a shortcut waiting in the hub.

npcs.name: Quill
npcs.title: The Collector

1: Old octopus idols, my friend. Carved stone, heavy, slightly cursed.
Carry one out through the exit ring, and it is mine.
2: My lantern burns for you now.
Every dive starts a little brighter.

relics: A relic! Splendid. Two more, if you would.
The second! The shelf is filling up.
Three! You have outdone yourself. The lantern is yours.

thanks.1: Ah, a new neighbour. Mind the ledge.
thanks.2: Take my lantern on every dive.

lines.meet: Hey! Over here! In the rock!
lines.ask: Blow this wall open, would you?

quests.done: The diver waves, free at last
It squeaks happily and swims home
